nameJa: エディトリアル・イタリック
conceptNote: 端正なサンセリフのFullscreenと、流れる赤いセリフ体イタリックのLive Chatを対比。中央揃えの誌面のように文字を組み、図を小さく添える。
prompt:
Image dimensions: 1760 x 1120 pixels. Aspect ratio: 11:7. A compact landscape postcard.
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE typographic Chrome Web Store tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen.
Concept02: an intelligent contemporary journal masthead, pairing graceful HIGH-CONTRAST SERIF ITALIC lettering with restrained regular-weight sans serif. Typography itself is the artwork; flat printed graphic design.
Exact visible text, each phrase ONLY ONCE: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Preserve this capitalization. Fullscreen remains one word. No other letters, slogans, numbers, labels, trademarks or tiny text.
Composition: beautifully centered editorial lockup with generous space on warm ivory. "YouTube" at top in regular ink-black sans serif, capital height at least80pixels, confidently legible, not tiny. A very fine red horizontal rule below. "Fullscreen" at center in large elegant regular sans serif, uncondensed, about150pixelcapheight. Directly below, "Live Chat" is the hero: exceptionally beautiful red high-contrast contemporary serif italic, large and fluid, roughly180pixelcapheight, fine hairlines and decisive thick strokes, precise custom-feeling kerning. This italic phrase must look art-directed, not like default TimesNewRoman, no ornate swashes or script. The two typographic voices form an intentional harmonious design.
Below the lockup, one small secondary frontal video diagram: fine ink16:9rectangle and four discrete fullscreen corners, small play triangle left and red outlined chat speech-bubble right FULLY INSIDE that same video frame; three tiny strokes in the bubble. No UI text. Keep this diagram modest, centered under the words, with ample blank ivory space. It must not dominate the typography.
All text and graphics inside8%safearea. Every word clear when the whole artwork is220x140. Palette warmivory, inkblack and softvermilion only. Flat crisp printing, no image texture.
No heavy chunky sans, condensedtype, bubble lettering, luxury ornamental clichés, gold, elaborate flourishes, 3D, bevelled letters, extrusion, paper shadows, plastic, glow, gradients, photos, scenes, people, fake interface, messages, user names or watermark. Emphasize exceptionally refined letterforms and harmonious optical spacing.
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
